resources.string: Connect Jellyfin or Emby to browse and play your own library.
Sign in with your server address and %1$s user.
Enter your server address and the %1$s user to sign in with. Your password is only used to sign in.
Selected libraries appear in home rows, search, and stream results.
No movie or series libraries are available to this user.
Show this server in Home, search, and stream results.

Titles open with your addons\' details and sync like any other catalog title, with playback and watched marks still sent to %1$s. Some titles may not match or play if your addons number or identify them differently.
Add titles you\'re watching in %1$s to Continue watching, along with its watched marks. Playback resumes from %1$s either way.
This signs you out of %1$s on this device. You can add it back anytime.
This user does not have access.
Could not connect to the server.
Sign in to this server again in Settings.
This item is no longer available on the server.
The server doesn\'t support this item.
Still checking this server\'s library. Try again in a moment.
Could not start playback from the server.
Could not update watched state on the server.
Titles from your media server can\'t be added to this library. Turn on Use addon metadata for the server to save them here.
Choose which libraries to show in Settings, under Content & Discovery, then Media servers.
This server uses a certificate your device does not trust. Sign in again to review it.
The certificate of this server changed. Sign in again to review it.
%1$s does not offer HTTPS. Continuing sends your sign-in details over plain HTTP, which anyone on the network can read. Only continue on a network you trust.
%1$s uses a certificate your device does not trust. Only continue if you recognise this fingerprint. It is saved on this device for this server only. Trust also applies to artwork and playback.

The certificate of %1$s is different from the one you trusted before. This can mean someone is intercepting the connection. Only trust the new one if you changed it yourself. Trust also applies to artwork and playback.
On a device already signed in to this server, open Quick Connect and enter this code.
The code expired. Try again for a new one.
Quick Connect is turned off on this server.
Quick Connect could not finish. Check the connection and try again.
This server uses a certificate you trusted, which this player cannot use directly. Try the other player in the player settings.
Manage this connection at addon.thekush.dev. To turn it off only on this device, use Settings → Content & Discovery.
